Page 156
July 4
Donald Burwell - 17 - badly curved spine ....
5 Roy J. Stiff - 66 - convert from presbiterism - inward groth (bladder) Dr. Helpless ...
5 Baby Lawrence Swertz - 112 mo. very thin - no nourishment but milk - Drs without hope - parents not going to sacraments or holy Mass promise to go.
Loraine Huber - 19 - Vocation -
Mrs. Mary Casey - 65 - brown's disease - a sort of palsey, has a fam- ily needs her .. ....
Rex C. Jacob - 47 - Serious heart trouble-
Melvin Shaul - 17 - Epyleptic ... since 11 - three of them To-day.
Joseph Ciak - 18 - infantile paralysis since birth ... in real sad con- dition ... Mentally, however, not so bad because resigned, tho twin - brother off in "The service. Enrolled To-day 5.
Page 157 July 10 Mrs. Mary A. Smith - 42 - Stomach cancer - seemingly hopeless, with prayer
11 Arcine Vervacke - 24 - reported by the Nazis as killed in action - Mother anxious - Comrad says he was not killed in action. That he saw his plane light O.K. etc.
Kieth Hall - 16 - bn a blue baby is till a blue invalid and non c. - was enrolled last week and has improved decidedly ever since. Now walks about as never before. Mother says she promised to take in- structions and have boy baptized if improvement was noticed.
12 Mrs. Roney - Help - Gen. Housework
Jean Thomelso - 17 - non Catholic - in Grace Hosp. debating whether to have her leg amputated. ... advised them to wait till Saturday (% phone Enrolled)
July 13 - July 18
Page 158 July 13 Lawrence Burk - 5 - has had very defective digestion ever since birth . bright boy otherwise.
